title: Hooks
description: Low-level hooks behind ConfigProvider: manage the theme, the language and lib-core's translations yourself.

reference.title: Reference
reference.useAutoTheme: Keeps the active theme in state and writes it as CSS variables on <html>. With "auto" or a { light, dark } pair it subscribes to prefers-color-scheme and unsubscribes on unmount. Returns the configured theme, its setter and the current system scheme.
reference.useLocale: Keeps the locale in state and switches the language of lib-core's built-in texts (en, zh or fr). Returns the locale and its setter.
reference.useI18n: Returns t and the i18next instance used by lib-core. It is a private instance, so your application's own i18next setup is never affected.
reference.global: useAutoTheme and useLocale change global state (CSS variables on <html>, lib-core's language). The demos below start from the site's current settings and restore them when they unmount.

standalone.title: Using the hooks without ConfigProvider
standalone.text: ConfigProvider is a thin wrapper around useAutoTheme and useLocale. If you don't need useConfig(), you can call the hooks directly, instead of a provider rather than inside one.

use-auto-theme.title: useAutoTheme
use-auto-theme.description: Switch the theme of the page with setTheme. systemTheme always reports the operating system scheme. Reset (or leaving the page) restores the site's theme.

use-locale.title: useLocale and useI18n
use-locale.description: setLocale changes lib-core's language; t() from useI18n returns lib-core's built-in texts in that language.
